create_workbook.title: Start a workbook
create_workbook.description: Start a container of work. It belongs to the signed-in caller and is empty until something is touched in it.

args.description: Whoever starts it owns it, resolved from the session rather than the request.

get_workbook.title: Open a workbook
get_workbook.description: Read one workbook by its id.

list_workbooks.title: List workbooks
list_workbooks.description: Every live workbook the signed-in caller owns, most recently changed first. This never lists anybody else's.

args.description: Whose workbooks to list, resolved from the session rather than the request.

update_workbook.title: Rename a workbook
update_workbook.description: Change a workbook's title or summary. What it holds is changed by working in it, not here.

delete_workbook.title: Retire a workbook
delete_workbook.description: Retire a workbook from every listing. What it referenced is left alone; the workbook was a record of the work, never the work itself.

touch.title: Note what was touched
touch.description: Record that this workbook has met something, or met it again. The same thing is one row whose last-seen moves, not a row per visit.

list_references.title: List what a workbook has touched
list_references.description: Everything one workbook has met, most recent first. A row survives the thing it names being deleted, because the label was captured when it was touched.

drop_reference.title: Drop a reference
drop_reference.description: Take one thing off a workbook's list without touching the thing itself.

record.title: Record an act
record.description: Record one act performed in this workbook, named by the declared action of the operation that performed it. The shortcut for that action moves in the same write.

args.description: The workbook it was performed in.
Who performed it, resolved from the session rather than the request.

list_uses.title: List what was done
list_uses.description: What happened in this workbook, most recent first.

list_shortcuts.title: List a workbook's shortcuts
list_shortcuts.description: The acts worth offering again here, most recently used first. Nothing in this list was authored: an entry exists because somebody did the thing in this workbook.

issue_share.title: Share a workbook by key
issue_share.description: Mint a key that opens one workbook for somebody without an account here. The key is returned once and never again; only its hash is kept.

args.description: What this key is being handed out for.
Who is issuing it, resolved from the session rather than the request.

list_shares.title: List a workbook's keys
list_shares.description: Every key issued for this workbook, live and retired. Retired ones are kept so a rotation leaves a trail of what was handed out and when it stopped.

retire_share.title: Retire a key
retire_share.description: Stop one key opening the workbook. The row is kept rather than deleted.

open_with_key.title: Open a shared workbook
open_with_key.description: Read one workbook by presenting a live key. A wrong key, a retired key and an unknown workbook are all the same answer, because telling them apart lets anyone probe which workbooks exist.

args.description: The key it was shared with.
